newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul court issues arrest warrant for ex-minister.
newsitem.headline: Seoul court issues arrest warrant for ex-minister.

text.p: A South Korean court on Saturday issued a warrant for the arrest of sacked defence minister Lee Yang-ho in connection with an arms deal.
"The court granted an arrest warrant for Mr Lee," an official of the Seoul Criminal Court told Reuters.

Senior prosecutor Ahn Kang-min told reporters that Lee, who was removed from President Kim Young-sam's cabinet last week, had admitted taking 150 million won ($181,000) from an arms dealer in April last year.

The main opposition National Congress for New Politics has charged that Lee and the arms dealer split a 300 million won ($362,000) bribe from Daewoo Heavy Industries Ltd last year to arrange a government purchase of military helicopters.

Lee has not commented publicly on the charges, but state media earlier quoted him as denying any wrongdoing. Daewoo said it gave money to the arms dealer but insisted it was a commission, not a bribe.
